selection_reason: A cohesive condensed Latin display with neutral text and authored Arabic shaping; exact wordmark SVG remains the only tall brand mark. Selection is a design specification, not a web licence assertion.

roles.uses: Latin proper product names and PDP title only
roles.fallback: 'Avenir Next Condensed', 'DIN Condensed', 'Roboto Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif

roles.uses: Latin body, UI, prices, claims, back and INCI
Arabic display headings only, never retypes Latin logo or names
Arabic UI, body and approved translated label copy

delivery: Flat assets/*.woff2 with exact upstream version, hashes, full font-specific copyright/licence evidence retained in data/production/licenses/ and distributable licence included with theme fonts. No download/import in this task.
runtime: No font-face or preload until local licensing/provenance is established. Prototype uses locally installed/system fonts via safe fallback stacks; future licensed BTS slots unchanged. No binaries copied or downloaded.
metrics: Measure glyph coverage, x-height/ascent/descent and shaping; never guess size-adjust/ascent-override. UI 16px/1.45, back at least 14px, AR line-height 1.7 and zero tracking; recheck E1 widths, all E2 200% cells, contact floor, INCI, CLS and Arabic line breaks.
